# Final comprehensive test of all observable behaviors
import sys
mods_to_remove = [k for k in list(sys.modules.keys()) if 'semver' in k]
for m in mods_to_remove:
    del sys.modules[m]

sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from semver.version import Version

print("=== m1: bump_prerelease ===")
# m1 observable behaviors
v1 = Version.parse('1.0.0-rc9')
r1 = v1.bump_prerelease()
assert str(r1) == '1.0.0-rc9.0', f"FAIL: rc9 -> {r1}"
print(f"  1.0.0-rc9 -> {r1} ✓")

v2 = Version.parse('1.0.0-rc.9')
r2 = v2.bump_prerelease()
assert str(r2) == '1.0.0-rc.10', f"FAIL: rc.9 -> {r2}"
print(f"  1.0.0-rc.9 -> {r2} ✓")

v3 = Version.parse('1.0.0-alpha')
r3 = v3.bump_prerelease()
assert str(r3) == '1.0.0-alpha.0', f"FAIL: alpha -> {r3}"
print(f"  1.0.0-alpha -> {r3} ✓")

# Verify ordering
assert Version.compare(v1, r1) < 0
assert Version.compare(v2, r2) < 0
assert Version.compare(v3, r3) < 0
print("  Ordering verified ✓")

print("\n=== m2/m3: bump_build ===")
# m2 observable behaviors
v4 = Version.parse('1.2.3+alpha')
r4 = v4.bump_build()
assert str(r4) == '1.2.3+alpha.0', f"FAIL: +alpha -> {r4}"
print(f"  1.2.3+alpha -> {r4} ✓")

v5 = Version.parse('1.2.3+build.9')
r5 = v5.bump_build()
assert str(r5) == '1.2.3+build.10', f"FAIL: +build.9 -> {r5}"
print(f"  1.2.3+build.9 -> {r5} ✓")

v6 = Version.parse('3.4.5-rc.1+build.9')
r6 = v6.bump_build()
assert str(r6) == '3.4.5-rc.1+build.10', f"FAIL: +build.9 with prerelease -> {r6}"
print(f"  3.4.5-rc.1+build.9 -> {r6} ✓")

# m3: no existing build should create build.1
v7 = Version.parse('1.2.3')
r7 = v7.bump_build()
assert str(r7) == '1.2.3+build.1', f"FAIL: no build -> {r7}"
print(f"  1.2.3 -> {r7} ✓")

print("\n=== All observable behaviors verified! ===")
